t: What Building Decommissioning Database Is All About
title: What Building Decommissioning Database Is All About
description: Building decommissioning is unbuilding: deconstruction (careful disassembly, 70%+ diversion) vs demolition (fast, landfilled). Material passports inventory the recoverable: steel, timber, brick, fixtures. Hazardous materials (asbestos, lead, PCBs) come out first, by licensed crews. The circular rule: design for disassembly next time — bolts, not glue. This database is the complete decommissioning record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Building Decommissioning Database: a complete reference database of full decommissioning record records.
